_notCoveredHere: The 1,386 are the retirement DECISION population only. The dollar values these nodes serve today are a different measurement and are answered in the P-351 CP1 (134,907 of Hays' 173,050 served keys carry a bare key that is also a declared-roll prop_id; 77,565 serve a market value; served marketValue equals the colliding account's own value on 12 rows, and on all 12 the node's own R account carries the identical figure, so the agreement is a value coincidence, not a wrong-parcel read).

Writer (b)'s 56,629 txgio_parcel-authority retirements are NOT in this file: they are not served parcel keys, they are the hollow account-keyed nodes P-180 meant to retire, and writer (b) did its job in Hays.

This file does not decide the 232 contradicted nodes' merits. Two published identifiers disagree about which parcel they name, so this lane refuses to pick a winner; whether the county is asked about them is an integration-seat question and is named as such in the P-351 CP1.
